The '''Krake's Planet system''' was a star system located within the [[Demetras sector/Legends|Demetras sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained [[Krake's Planet]].
